d: A robotic entity with a mechanical build, featuring a blue-grey metallic chassis accented by orange and white panels. The face is a complex mechanical assembly with glowing neon green ocular slits, topped by a white, boxy helmet-like head with a yellow crossing stripe and a side-mounted camera lens. The outfit consists of heavy industrial armor in shades of dark charcoal, blue-grey, and orange, including a thick white scarf around the neck and a shoulder-mounted grey electronic device connected by a coiled blue cable. Signature details include a large blue and white rifle marked with the word "NERD" and various mechanical joints and plating throughout the torso and arms. BODY COLOR: Blue-grey and charcoal LEGS: Plantigrade, mechanical robotic feet.
